project.name: QH :: Module :: Party (parent)
project.description: Parent/aggregator for the Party domain (56 tables, one bounded context, one PARTY schema/database). BIAN-style Party subsystem: PARTY (concrete identity root) with PERSON and ORGANIZATION detail tables, geographic/classification reference catalogs, addresses, contact points, identifiers, names, roles, group/UBO memberships, signature specimens, customer/officer relationships and a central audit trail. Intentionally independent of the product-builder modules - it only depends on qh-common, matching the project's SOA-style module independence. Split into two Maven sub-modules for easier management (mirroring qh-module-productbuilder's reference/core split), while both share one Java package root (ir.bank.qh.party.*) and deploy together as one persistence unit (PartyPersistenceConfig in qh-app scans "ir.bank.qh.party" as a whole). Every table lives in its own PARTY database schema and every tenant-scoped entity is isolated per institution via Hibernate's @TenantId discriminator-based multi-tenancy (see ir.bank.qh.common.tenant in qh-common).
